items.t: Oil in spark plug wells causes misfires
items.job: Replace cam cover gaskets and plug tube seals, plus damaged coils
items.note: CarComplaints lists about $2,300 on average when several coils, plugs and a converter were also replaced.

items.t: Ignition coil failures and misfire (extended coverage)
items.job: Replace ignition coil (one) and spark plug
items.note: CarComplaints lists about $300 on average. Ford's old extended coverage has likely ended.

items.t: Water in coil wells causes misfires after rain or washing
items.job: Replace cowl seals and coil boots, dry wells, replace damaged coil

items.t: Automatic transmission slipping or failing
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with remanufactured unit

items.t: Harsh shifts or delayed engagement into Reverse
items.job: Transmission fluid service and computer update
items.note: Internal repairs cost much more if the fluid service and update do not help.

items.t: Front lower ball joint nuts may loosen (recall)
items.job: Check and tighten ball joint nuts, replace ball joints if needed
items.note: Free under recall 00V-359 if not already done.

items.t: Worn front lower ball joints
items.job: Replace front lower ball joint or steering knuckle (one side)
items.note: Price is higher if the knuckle must be replaced with the joint. Add an alignment.

items.t: Front sway bar bushings clunk
items.job: Install updated front sway bar, bushings and brackets

items.t: Worn tie rod ends
items.job: Replace outer tie rod ends (pair) and align

items.t: Wheel bearing hum or growl
items.job: Replace wheel bearing or hub (one)

items.t: Overheating from a faulty thermostat
items.job: Replace thermostat and refill coolant

items.t: Cracked coolant tank, thermostat housing or radiator
items.job: Replace coolant expansion tank or thermostat housing
items.note: A radiator costs more: about $150–400 in parts and 2–3 hours.

items.t: Hydraulic cooling fan runs slow, overheats in traffic
items.job: Replace hydraulic fan control actuator
items.note: A fan motor or pump costs more if that is the failed part.

items.t: Water pump hose may burst (service program)
items.job: Replace water pump hose
items.note: Covered under Ford program 04B21 for eligible cars; otherwise a hose is a small repair.

items.t: One side blows hot air with A/C on
items.job: Replace dual coolant control valve

items.t: A/C refrigerant leak or compressor failure
items.job: Replace A/C compressor and recharge
items.note: Fixing a small leak and recharging costs much less.

items.t: Power window regulator breaks
items.job: Replace window regulator (one door)

items.t: Door handle cracks or breaks
items.job: Replace door handle or latch linkage (one door)

items.t: Moisture inside headlamps
items.job: Reseal headlamp or replace headlamp assembly
items.note: Resealing is cheap; a new lamp assembly is at the high end.

items.t: 17-inch chrome wheels can crack at lug holes (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace affected wheels
items.note: Free under recall 03V-136 if not already done.

items.t: Fuel tank can crack and leak (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel tank
items.note: Free under recall 05V-113 if not already done.

items.t: Cracked PCV hose causes rough idle or stalling (service program)
items.job: Replace PCV hose assembly
items.note: Covered under Ford campaign 08-N-01 for eligible cars.

items.t: Electronic throttle fault and reduced power
items.job: Clean or replace electronic throttle body
items.note: Cleaning is cheap; a new throttle body is at the high end.

items.t: Electric parking brake fault message
items.job: Diagnose and replace parking brake actuator or module

items.t: ABS and traction control lights from wheel speed sensor faults
items.job: Replace ABS wheel speed sensor

items.t: Airbag light on from failed clockspring
items.job: Replace steering column clockspring

items.t: Alternator stops charging
items.job: Replace alternator

items.t: Fuel pump failure or hard hot starts
items.job: Replace in-tank fuel pump

items.t: Catalytic converter fouled or failed
items.job: Replace catalytic converter (one side) and oxygen sensor

items.t: Water pump leaks or loses its impeller
items.job: Replace water pump and refill coolant
items.note: The V8 job takes longer than the V6.
